subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime helpers on the session, settings-file, configuration and UI-event paths: scene .bik video loading, race-finish and restart gating, session-UI dispatch, settings-file and player-profile bootstrap, environment setup, session-config slot activation, config-token scanning, pit-crew animation load/cleanup, progress-bar event encoding, screenshot capture, and resource-handle registration. Owners are mostly UNKNOWN in the packet; classes below are GUESS groupings except the packet-DERIVED PitCrewAnimationStruct.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 20 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. One packet-DERIVED owner (0x004A2220 PitCrewAnimationStruct) forms the pit-crew animation struct init/cleanup; the load-setup function 0x004A4900 that allocates its animation objects is grouped under a GUESS PitCrewAnimationManager. The eighteen remaining functions have packet-UNKNOWN owners and are grouped conservatively by shared globals: SessionLifecycleManager (scene video load, race finish, session-UI dispatch, session-type guard, restart gate; all touch dword_7CD8C0 / dword_7C569C / dword_7CE25x), SettingsFileManager (autoload config, profile bootstrap, settings swap-write, environment setup, player-name extraction, name-compare-and-format; all touch byte_5EA438 and the settings/season directory globals), SessionConfigObject (six-slot config activation + state-gated bitmask test; both read this+0x1F78), ConfigTokenScanner (token scan + dual-path teardown), and a GenericRuntimeObject catch-all (progress-bar event encode, screenshot handler, resource-handle registration). The shared dispatch/session-state globals are captured as ISessionDispatch / ISessionState / IProgressBarEventQueue interfaces and the GameActionStateMachine / SessionStateMachine / RestartCountdownStateMachine state machines.

function_roles.role: Loads the scene .bik video: guard on scene entry (dword_8AC490 + 396*dword_8AC48C) non-null and dword_7D032C==1, extracts directory from scene name, formats base+dir+'.bik', loads via FileLoadWithRetryLoop; returns 1 when the guard fails.

Race-completion handler: per-driver race commentary, advance action state machine to post-race state 5, session-state transition, conditional menu-mode switch on player finish flag + timing expression > 60.0 + session mode != 19, dispatch in-race event 19; always returns 0.

Session-state UI dispatch: SessionStateCheck(dword_7CD25C) -> vtable dispatch (offset 28, args 36/35 for states 3/2), then UITextInputHandler + UIListSelectionHandler + SoundEffectLoadPlay on non-null result; else returns state value.

Session-type guard for command dispatch: returns 0 unless dispatch interface dword_7CD8C0 non-null and (session type 2 or 6, or HUD-disable flag byte_7CE254 set); then forwards a2/a3 to sub_4989E0 and returns 1.

Session restart/main-menu gate polled by GamePostMainLoop: mini-restart flag -> cleanup pass + return 4; full-restart flags -> return 6; countdown state machine; session-type/init-guard path; input-action-map menu transition scan; returns session type dword_7C569C.

Scans settings-file token stream stripping separators, compares each token against reference path this+0x4 (fallback byte_5EA438), invokes virtual callback through vtable at this+0x0 on match; returns 1 once matched else 0.
Runs three dual-path resource lookups: against global path token word_5C30B4, then custom path this[1] (fallback byte_5EA438), then global again; always returns 1.

Init/reinit-cleanup hybrid for the pit crew animation struct: reset word/byte state fields, init this+0x44..0x60 region, release 3D sound source (this+0x64), buffer (this+0x6C) and 28-byte-element array (this+0x74, count at base-4); returns the freed array pointer.

Loads pit crew animation MAS files: gate on dword_8AB6E4 != 2 and (target is player vehicle or detail level dword_7CF884 >= 3), builds directory-relative MAS paths, allocates/loads 10sec, normal and player-only pit-director animation objects into this[4]/this[3]/this[5], frees temporaries, returns comparison of argument struct.
Trivial wrapper: one-time static initialization of autoload config block byte_7CE498 via StaticInitBulk; returns its result.

Player profile-file bootstrap: iterates settings directory (dword_5EC440 or byte_5EA438), copies an existing profile via StringCopyFileCheckDispatch, else reads the default 'PlayerNameNever...' text file and recurses to create the default profile, setting this+0x49A8/0x49A9 flags.

Persists settings file: builds '.tmp' name (extension stripped from byte_5EA438), clears read-only (attr 128) on temp+destination, logs attempt, enumerates dir + vtable dispatch, closes handle, SettingsFileInit + ConfigFileParser into dword_7C73E8, deletes old destination, renames temp over it, logs result; returns 0.

Reads text file and sets up environment: resolves path into receiver buffer, creates every directory level, selects wet/dry environment from byte_7CB710 bit 0, loads AIW scene (dword_8AC488) and vehicle data (dword_8AC390), registers cleanup strings, copies save file, selects track environment, cleans device list, reads settings; returns 0.
Extracts player/.plr filename: module-manager string (NullTerminatedStringLengthAt0x11c(dword_7CD25C)) or object name trimmed after last backslash and at '.plr' suffix; copies with length limit a3-1.

Activates one of six session config slots: copies per-slot values into active fields, clamps against stored min/max (ClampByRange / ByteClamp / FloatClamp / inline), presets control field this+0x1C54 to 1 or 7 for slots 1/2, applies via sub_4B1190(-1.0); returns 1, or 0 out of range.

Compares input name to stored name this+0x1F9C; on match builds season-dir + name path, object-ID lookup, audio load/decode, settings init, buffer copy, 5-step session init; returns 1 on success else 0.
State-gated bitmask test: returns true when state this+0x1F78 != 5, otherwise whether bit (1<<a2) is set in bitmask this+0x2AB4; per-frame predicate for AIShiftPattern / BrakeBiasSetup.

Packs progress-bar/session event parameters into a bitfield word from dword_7C56A4 base index (a5 + ((a4 + ((a3 + (base << 6)) << 10)) << 8)), stores it at this+0, secondary payload a6 at this+4, resets flag this+0x1AC to -1; returns packed word.

Per-frame screenshot handler: scans input keycode array word_7CB21C (dword_7CB218 entries) for key 88 ('X'), saves screen via sub_551FD0 to season dir dword_5EC478 (fallback byte_5EA438), localizes+renders 'Screen Saved', runs camera viewport setup + vehicle visibility culling; returns sub_557120(dword_8AFE88).
Resource-handle registration helper: stores ResourceLookupDispatcher(a2) at this+0x4, dispatches 4-byte header (this) and 2-byte sub-field (this+2) via ConditionalDispatch_6bd0; returns 1.

classes.name: PitCrewAnimationStruct
classes.responsibility: Pit crew animation object container initialized and cleaned by 0x004A2220: a 3D sound source, a raw buffer, and a counted array of 28-byte animation elements, plus word/byte state flags and a position/vector region.

classes.name: PitCrewAnimationManager
classes.responsibility: GUESS loader/owner of the per-vehicle pit crew animation set: loads and stores the 10sec, normal and (player-only) pit-director animation objects into embedded slots this[3]/this[4]/this[5], gated by player/detail-level conditions.

classes.name: SessionLifecycleManager
classes.responsibility: GUESS grouping of session lifecycle helpers whose packet owners are UNKNOWN: scene video load, race-finish handling, session-state UI dispatch, session-type-gated command dispatch, and the restart/main-menu gate. All five manipulate the shared session-state globals (dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface, dword_7C569C session type, dword_7CE25x restart flags).

classes.name: SettingsFileManager
classes.responsibility: GUESS grouping of settings-file and player-profile helpers: autoload config init, profile-file bootstrap, settings write-with-backup, environment/file setup, player-name extraction, and name-compare-and-format. All manipulate the default-directory global byte_5EA438 and settings/season directory globals.

classes.name: SessionConfigObject
classes.responsibility: GUESS session configuration object holding six stored configuration slots plus active/current fields: slot activation copies per-slot values into active fields and clamps them against stored per-group min/max bounds (0x004B0EF0), and a state-gated bitmask predicate reads the same slot-index/state field (0x004B15D0).

classes.name: ConfigTokenScanner
classes.responsibility: GUESS scanner object that walks settings-file token streams through a resource lookup handle, strips separators, compares tokens against a reference path (this+0x4), and invokes a virtual callback on match; the same receiver runs the three-lookup dual-path file teardown.

classes.name: GenericRuntimeObject
classes.responsibility: GUESS catch-all for the remaining single-method runtime helpers with UNKNOWN owners: progress-bar/session event bitfield encoding, the per-frame screenshot handler, and resource-handle registration. Each operates on its own small this-layout; kept separate from the other classes because their fields have no shared ownership evidence.

state_machines.name: GameActionStateMachine
transitions: advance to post-race state 5 with parameter 1 via callee 0x0040CDE0 on the action object at dword_5EA510 (RaceFinishHandler 0x004A0BA0)

conditional switch to menu/mode select via 0x004A0C60 when the player vehicle finish flag is 1, the timing expression (vehicle float index 4142 + flt_8ACF90 - dbl_8AFEA0) exceeds 60.0, and the session mode dword_8AD298 is not 19

state_machines.name: SessionStateMachine
transitions: state 3 -> indirect dispatch through vtable of dword_7CD8C0 offset 28 with argument 36; state 2 -> same with argument 35 (SessionStateDispatch 0x004A0DF0)
session-state transition to state 1 via callee 0x004EF5A0 in RaceFinishHandler (0x004A0BA0)
session-type gate: dispatch runs when session type dword_7C569C is 2 or 6, or the HUD-disable flag byte_7CE254 is set (SessionTypeGuard 0x004A0E70)

state_machines.name: RestartCountdownStateMachine
transitions: byte_7CE269 set -> subtract double dbl_8AFE98 from float dword_7CE26C (RestartGate 0x004A0FD0)
dword_7CE26C <= 0 -> clear byte_7CE269, zero dword_7CE26C, set dword_7CE258 = 1
dword_7CE258 == 2 -> set to 1 and continue at shared label
sub_485B90 result -1 or 3 -> full restart (return 6); result 4 -> return 4
frame/counter dword_7CE250 post-increment feeds sub_485B90(tick, byte_7CE25F); dword_7CE264==1 gate selects the dword_7C569C=6 path or ConditionalInitGuard

interfaces.name: ISessionDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Vtable-dispatched UI/message interface reached through the dispatch object at dword_7CD8C0 (method offset 28, arguments 35/36); used to route session-state UI handling and session-type-gated command dispatch.

interfaces.name: ISessionState
interfaces.purpose: Session/game-action state access: SessionStateCheck(dword_7CD25C) query, SessionStateTransition, and the post-race action advance at dword_5EA510; drives finish handling, UI dispatch and restart gating.

interfaces.name: IProgressBarEventQueue
interfaces.purpose: Bitfield-packed UI progress-bar / session-event enqueue: writes the packed word at this+0, a secondary payload at this+4, and resets a flag at this+0x1AC, indexed off the session-type base dword_7C56A4.

interfaces.name: IPlayerVehicleAccess
interfaces.purpose: Locate the player vehicle slot and the vehicle array/active-pointer globals: player pointer dword_7C54E8, array base dword_5EC6D8, active vehicle pointers dword_7C54F0 (resolved through sub_4D1B50 and iterated in the restart cleanup loop).

compatibility_contracts.name: BinkVideoSceneLoad
compatibility_contracts.description: BinkVideoLoader (0x004A09F0) runs only when the scene entry at dword_8AC490 + 396*dword_8AC48C is non-null and dword_7D032C == 1; the .bik path is built as base (dword_5EC418, or byte_5EA438 when null) + the scene directory component + '.bik' ('%s%s%s' via 0x0058815F) and loaded through FileLoadWithRetryLoop (0x004F9B70). A replacement must preserve the 396-byte scene stride, the format, and the backslash directory-extraction rule.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionConfigSlotLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: SessionConfigSlotActivate (0x004B0EF0) manages six configuration slots (a2 in 1..6): per-slot values live at 36-byte stride with a 24-byte byte group (0xCE4) and a 4*(9*a2+369) group (0x5C4); every active field is copied then clamped against its stored min/max via ClampByRange (0x0047F1F0), ByteClamp (0x00464720) or FloatClamp (0x004646C0), with two inline clamps (0x23FC, 0x27C8); slots 1/2 preset the control field this+0x1C54 to 1/7. A replacement must preserve slot strides, the active-field anchors and the clamp semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsFileSwapWrite
compatibility_contracts.description: SettingsFileWriteWithBackup (0x004B0770) writes a '.tmp' sibling (extension stripped from byte_5EA438, 'tmp' appended), clears the read-only attribute (value 128) on both temp and destination, enumerates the directory and dispatches vtable callbacks, then runs SettingsFileInit + ConfigFileParser into dword_7C73E8, deletes the old destination and renames the temp over it. A replacement must reproduce the temp-then-rename swap and attribute handling.

compatibility_contracts.name: ProfileFileBootstrap
compatibility_contracts.description: PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileFileCreateRead (0x004B03F0) scans the settings directory (dword_5EC440, or byte_5EA438 when null) for an existing profile entry; on a hit it formats base+entry and copies the file via StringCopyFileCheckDispatch (0x004B04E0), on a miss it reads the default 'PlayerNameNever...' text file (0x004B09A0) and recurses (0x004B03F0) to create the default profile, setting this+0x49A8/0x49A9. The directory iterator is torn down before the result is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitCrewAnimationArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: PitCrewAnimStructInitAndCleanup (0x004A2220) owns a counted array at this+0x74 whose element count is stored in the dword at allocation_base-4, with 28-byte elements destructed via ShortComputation_d4d0 (0x004DD4D0) and freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); a 3D sound source lives at this+0x64 (destroyed via F_3DSoundSourceDestructor 0x00545150 when the subsystem-liveness guard dword_8AFE88 is set) and a buffer at this+0x6C. A replacement must preserve the count-at-base-minus-4 header and 28-byte element stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: RestartRequestReturnValues
compatibility_contracts.description: RestartGate (0x004A0FD0) exposes a fixed request encoding to GamePostMainLoop: 4 = mini-restart (vehicle cleanup pass over dword_5C329C active vehicles dword_7C54F0 via FieldCopy_c330, then return), 6 = full restart (returned when byte_7CE25E or byte_7CE260 is set, when dword_7CE258 is 1 under the dword_7CE264==1 gate, or when sub_485B90 yields -1 or 3), otherwise the effective session type dword_7C569C. A replacement must preserve these return codes and the cleanup iteration.

compatibility_contracts.name: RaceFinishFlow
compatibility_contracts.description: RaceFinishHandler (0x004A0BA0) triggers per-driver race commentary (0x00419C50), then advances the action state machine to post-race state 5 (0x0040CDE0) and the session state to 1 (0x004EF5A0) unless the driver already finished or the qualifying-DSQ switch dword_7CE814 is set; on player finish it conditionally switches to menu mode and finally dispatches in-race event 19 (0x004D8760). A replacement must preserve the guard ordering.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScreenshotKeyAndSavePath
compatibility_contracts.description: RenderScreenSave (0x004B40A0) triggers on input keycode 88 ('X') in the action-key array word_7CB21C (dword_7CB218 entries), saves the screen via sub_551FD0 with screen dimensions dword_8B8DD4/dword_8B8DD8 into directory dword_5EC478 (or byte_5EA438), localizes 'Screen Saved' (aScreenSaved 0x005D240C) via the string table (byte_5EC4C0) into byte_5EC4CC and renders it through the text render target dword_7CD204 (0x0045BD10), then always runs camera viewport setup (0x004FBD70 on unk_8AFFC8) and vehicle visibility culling (0x004B3DC0), returning sub_557120(dword_8AFE88).

compatibility_contracts.name: ProgressBarEventBitfieldEncoding
compatibility_contracts.description: ProgressBarEventEncode (0x004B33B0) packs event parameters into a single bitfield word: result = a5 + ((a4 + ((a3 + ((dword_7C56A4 + 8*(a7 + 4*a2)) << 6)) << 10)) << 8), stores it at this+0, a secondary payload at this+4, and resets this+0x1AC to -1. A replacement must preserve the shift/accumulate order for identical UI event encoding.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConfigTokenStreamFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: ScanSettingsTokensForPathMatch (0x004A1B90) reads a settings-file token stream through the resource-lookup handle (0x00566E20 / line reader 0x00566CC0), checks leading bytes against the delimiter unk_5C30B8 (via sub_596C80), and truncates on substring tokens word_5C30B4 / asc_5C30B0 (via sub_587C20); the teardown path reuses the same global path token (0x00566CF0) in FileStreamCleanup (0x004A1F10). A replacement must preserve the token/separator globals and the strip-compare callback protocol.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitCrewAnimationMASPathBuild
compatibility_contracts.description: PitCrewAnimationLoadSetup (0x004A4900) builds directory-relative MAS paths from byte_5EA438 with per-track subdirectories (0x0053CBC0 assembles the MAS names; StringRegistry 0x0053C800 registers the directory; 0x00587C03/0x00566650/0x005665B0 copy and join path components), using the MAS-suffix string globals (aTeamMas 0x005CD5D8, aPitsMas 0x005CD5CC, aCdbMas 0x005CD5C4, aCmapsMas 0x005CCEB0, aPits10secPitcr 0x005CD5AC, aPitcrew10sec02 0x005CD598, aPitcrewnormal0 0x005CD554, aPitsNormalPitc 0x005CD568 / aPitsLeftPitcre 0x005CD580 selected by byte_5EA3EC, aPitdirector0 0x005CD544, aPits 0x005CD5E4) and season-directory globals dword_5EC3D8 / dword_5EC420 / dword_5EC428. The load runs only when the scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 is not 2 and either the target is the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8) or the detail level dword_7CF884 is >= 3. A replacement must keep the MAS file-name formats, the byte_5EA3EC left/normal selection, and the load gate.

compatibility_contracts.name: NameCompareAndFormatFlow
compatibility_contracts.description: NameCompareAndFormat (0x004B1410) compares the input name to the stored name this+0x1F9C (via 0x00588410); on match it formats the season-directory + name path ('%s%s' format global aSS 0x005BE860, season dir dword_5EC3D8), performs an object-ID lookup (0x005684A0), loads/decodes the audio file (0x00567F40), re-runs settings-file init (0x004B0930), copies the buffer, and runs the 5-step session init (0x004B0720). A replacement must keep the path-format and lookup ordering.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsEnvironmentBootstrap
compatibility_contracts.description: ReadTextFileAndSetupEnvironment (0x004B09A0) creates every directory level of the resolved path (CreateDirectoryAWrapper 0x00589671, prefix builder 0x00587DD0), selects the wet/dry environment from byte_7CB710 bit 0 (via sub_4AE750), loads the AIW scene when dword_8AC488 is non-zero (AIW 0x004C54F0) and vehicle data when dword_8AC390 is non-zero (CurrentVehicleAccessor 0x004C4080 on unk_8AC388), registers the receiver's 0x1B4 path string for cleanup (0x00415730 on dword_5EA5E8), then copies the save file, selects the track environment, cleans the device list (dword_7C73E8) and reads settings.

compatibility_contracts.name: DebugLogSink
compatibility_contracts.description: SettingsFileWriteWithBackup (0x004B0770) writes debug messages to the debug-log buffer dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0) gated by StringSplitLoop (0x004D7A50) with the source-file string globals aDDevF119992002_20 (0x005D22E0) and the message strings aAttemptingToSa (0x005D22C4) / aRetcodeDForRen (0x005D1FF4). A replacement must preserve the debug-sink global and the format-argument source-file identity for matching diagnostics.

compatibility_contracts.name: AutoloadConfigBlock
compatibility_contracts.description: AutoLoadConfigFileInit (0x004A7000) performs a one-time static initialization of the autoload configuration block byte_7CE498 via StaticInitBulk and returns its result; the same block is passed to PlayerFile_Restart in the game restart path. A replacement must keep the byte_7CE498 block and the single-shot init semantics.
